artifacts.description: feat(io): read and write the unpacked .sltwx folder form

acceptance_criteria: A documented `Document { manifest: Manifest, model: serde_json::Value, properties: Option<serde_json::Value> }` (fields public), and `pub fn read_unpacked(dir: &Path) -> Result<Document, FormatError>` and `pub fn write_unpacked(dir: &Path, doc: &Document) -> Result<(), FormatError>`, both documented with a reference to FILE_FORMAT.md.

`write_unpacked` creates `dir` if it is missing and writes each file with `to_canonical_json` (`manifest.json` via `write_manifest`). It writes `properties.json` only when `properties` is `Some`, and removes a stale `properties.json` when it is `None`. It never touches any other entry in `dir` (`cache/`, `thumbnail.png`, `attachments/`, unknown files stay byte for byte).

`FormatError` gains documented variants (never a panic) for: an I/O error (with the path), a missing required file (naming `manifest.json` or `model.json`), and a directory whose extension does not match the manifest's `kind` (`.sltwx` ↔ `part`, `.sltwxa` ↔ `assembly`, `.sltwxd` ↔ `drawing`). `model.json` or `properties.json` that is not a JSON object is the invalid-field variant naming the file.

Tests (each in a fresh directory under `std::env::temp_dir()` with a unique name, removed at the end; no new dev-dependencies): a committed fixture folder `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/bracket.sltwx/` (canonical `manifest.json` with kind `part`, a `model.json` copied from FILE_FORMAT.md's part example in canonical form, and a `properties.json` `{"title": "Bracket"}`) is read, written to a new `bracket.sltwx/`, and every written file equals the fixture byte for byte; unknown top-level fields in `model.json` (`"x_future": {"a": 1}`) round-trip unchanged; writing with `properties: None` over a folder that has `properties.json` removes it, and a pre-existing `cache/body-b-1.brep` (any bytes) and `thumbnail.png` are unchanged after the write; errors: missing `manifest.json`; missing `model.json`; `model.json` that is `[1, 2]`; a manifest of kind `assembly` in a folder named `x.sltwx`; a folder name with no extension; a path that is a file, not a directory. Each returns the right variant.
`swx-io` has no `unsafe` and still has no workspace dependencies; `swx-core`, `swx-sketch` and `swx-kernel` are unchanged; `Cargo.toml` dependencies unchanged from #184.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
